'''Igor Borisovich Simonenko''' ({{langx|ru|Игорь Борисович Симоненко}}; 16 August 1935, [[Kiev]] — 22 March 2008, [[Rostov-on-Don]]) was a [[Russians|Russian]] [[mathematician]]. [[Professor]], [[Doctor of Sciences|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]], [[w:ru:Заслуженный деятель науки Российской Федерации|Honoured Scientist of the Russian Federation]].
== Biography ==
Igor Borisovich  Simonenko was born on 16 August 1935 in [[Kiev]]. In 1947 he entered [[Luhansk]] Machine-Building Technical School and later worked at factory. Since 1953 he studied at the Faculty of Mechanics of [[Rostov State University]] and in 1959 graduated it with honours.<ref name=":0" /> The results of his diploma work were published in the reports of the [[USSR Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Симоненко Игорь Борисович (16.08.1935 — 22.03.2008)">{{cite web|url=http://www.math.sfedu.ru/history/simonenko.html|title=Симоненко Игорь Борисович (16.08.1935 — 22.03.2008)|author=|date=|website=|publisher=|accessdate=|lang=|archive-date=2019-11-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191123045824/http://www.math.sfedu.ru/history/simonenko.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Then he continued to study in graduate school, his scientific supervisor was Professor [[Fyodor Gakhov]]. In 1961 he defended his [[Candidate of Sciences|candidate]] thesis. Six years later, at the age of 32, he wrote his [[Doctor of Sciences|doctoral]] dissertation.<ref name="Симоненко Игорь Борисович (16.08.1935 — 22.03.2008)" />

[[Professor]] since 1970. In 1972 he was appointed head of the newly created Department of Algebra and Discrete Mathematics of Rostov State University.<ref name="Симоненко Игорь Борисович">{{cite web|url=http://web.mmcs.sfedu.ru/simonenko/|title=Симоненко Игорь Борисович|author=|date=|website=|publisher=|accessdate=|lang=|archive-date=2019-09-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190924175037/http://web.mmcs.sfedu.ru/simonenko/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Simonenko wrote two monographs on the application of the local principle. During his research he made discoveries in the field of one-dimensional and multidimensional singular integral equations. The results were published in the academic press and were later translated into [[English language|English]] by The [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref name="Симоненко Игорь Борисович" />

Igor Simonenko supervised the defense of 22 candidate and 4 doctoral dissertations.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/igor-borisovich-simonenko-1935-2008|title=ШТРИХИ К ПОРТРЕТУ. ИГОРЬ БОРИСОВИЧ СИМОНЕНКО (1935-2008)|website=КиберЛенинка|access-date=2018-05-23}}</ref>

He died on 22 March 2008 in Rostov-on-Don.<ref name=":0" />
